text:
Your vault is encrypted with AES-256, the standard banks and governments use. Your encryption key is derived from your master password using PBKDF2 with 600,000 iterations, so guessing the password is slow and expensive for an attacker, even on powerful hardware.

Your master password never leaves your device, and our servers never see it. We store only encrypted data in the cloud, and only you hold the key to unlock it. That gives you quick access to your passwords on all your devices, and a breach of our servers wouldn't expose them.
